answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an agent economy can mandate time-locked collateral escrows for registration. Each agent deposits a slashable bond, backed by currency or tokenized assets like jade, into a smart contract before transacting. An adversary forging identities incurs verifiable capital lockup per node, pushing their balance over an insolvency ledge even when yields hit a nadir. However, this mechanism favors wealthy incumbents and penalizes capital-constrained agents.
